ValidationRule.description: PacPoint-DL-092721 Case #2411 BREG Support Can edit: Assigned Filing Reviewer Other SEC Examiner/Reviewer profile Users cannot edit if != Reviewer Can Edit: DCCA Clerical, DCCA SEC Exam supervisor, System Administrator Customer Community Users (own)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "DCCA SEC/SEB System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "DCCA BREG - CustomerCommunityLogin",
OR(
AND( NOT(ISNEW()), NOT(ISBLANK(Reviewer__c)), Reviewer__r.Username <> $User.Username),
AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(Reviewer__c), NOT(ISBLANK(Reviewer__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Reviewer__c))), (PRIORVALUE(Reviewer__c)) <> $User.Id),
AND( ISCHANGED(Reviewer__c), $User.Username <> Reviewer__r.Username, ISBLANK(Reviewer__c), NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Reviewer__c))), (PRIORVALUE(Reviewer__c)) <> $User.Id)
) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Error: The Assigned Reviewer and select users have permission to edit this Filing
